evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Contribute to the structure and maintainability of our dbt project through testing, documentation, and CI/CD best practices.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize testing, documentation, data quality, governance, and reliability across dbt, Snowflake, and ingestion sections with no speed/shipping language, landing as rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Data is at the heart of Flibco's ability to scale intelligently and compete effectively.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would affect internal business decision-making and operational efficiency at a mobility/transportation company, without stated regulatory or financial-reporting consequence, landing as moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Design, develop, and maintain modular, scalable dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools (dbt, Snowflake, Fivetran) appear directly in responsibilities with an existing multi-layer dbt project and a 'wider data team' referenced, but the role is also asked to build foundational governance and semantic-layer initiatives from scratch, indicating a mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, develop, and maintain modular, scalable dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers. Work with and optimise our Snowflake environment, including data modelling, query performance, cost awareness, and access management.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools, layered architecture, and precise technical tasks (schema management, access management, lineage tracking) rather than generic boilerplate, indicating hiring-manager authorship.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build trusted and well-documented data models that enable analysts and business stakeholders to work confidently with data.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building the data platform itself (self-service analytics, semantic modelling, governance) for internal data consumers, landing as internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Your mission is to design, build, and evolve the data platform that powers decision-making across the business.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The JD frames the role as designing and evolving the platform's core components and standards, with explicit ownership language ('take ownership of your work'), landing as strategic.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling, AI-assisted coding, or AI-consuming data infrastructure language appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Contribute to the structure and maintainability of our dbt project through testing, documentation, and CI/CD best practices.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is framed as an owned responsibility across multiple sections (dbt project structure, ingestion pipeline monitoring) rather than a listed tool, landing as responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Contribute to pipeline monitoring, schema management, testing, and overall data reliability.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability, monitoring, and data quality are recurring secondary concerns tied to pipeline and platform operation rather than compliance or stakeholder-trust framing, landing as moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Beyond maintaining existing systems, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of our data platform, engineering standards, and analytics capabilities.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD explicitly frames the role as both maintaining existing systems and building new governance/semantic-layer foundations, landing as mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: We embrace a hybrid work model, offering flexibility between remote work and on-site collaboration.
